title: IFC relationship
description: One IfcRelationship, as the relationship object itself. The link is the reference rather than the row: the component sits on each related node and its reference name is the id of the node the relationship relates it to. One row serves every link a single relationship object makes, so an IfcRelAggregates with four hundred parts is one row and four hundred references.

expressId.description: The line number the relationship had in the file.

ifcType.description: The relationship class, such as IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure.

relating.description: Which attribute the reference points at, such as RelatingStructure. The node holding the component is on the Related side. Absent when the relationship has only one end -- a virtual space boundary bounds a space and no element -- and then the reference names the relationship itself rather than another node.

attributes.description: Any further attribute the relationship carries in its own right, such as IfcRelSpaceBoundary.PhysicalOrVirtualBoundary.
